unreachable.title: We couldn't reach SparkCircles
unreachable.caption: Check your connection and try again.

welcome.tagline: Organize family life with families near you.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.intro: It takes 2 minutes. You can add more about your family later.
signUp.lastNameHelper: Others only see the first letter.
signUp.passwordHelper: At least 10 characters. Avoid common passwords.
signUp.terms: I accept the <terms>terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>
signUp.termsPlain: I accept the terms of use and the privacy policy
signUp.marketing: Send me news and ideas from SparkCircles

fieldErrors.email: Check your email address, it looks incomplete.
fieldErrors.password: Use at least 10 characters, and avoid common passwords like 'motdepasse123'.
fieldErrors.adult: Tick this box to confirm you're 18 or older. SparkCircles is for adults only.
fieldErrors.terms: Tick this box to accept the terms and privacy policy.

checkInbox.title: Check your inbox
checkInbox.body: We've sent a link to {{email}}. Tap it within 24 hours to confirm your email.
checkInbox.bodyNoEmail: We've sent you a link. Tap it within 24 hours to confirm your email.
checkInbox.resent: New link sent. You can ask again in a moment.
checkInbox.helpBody: Look in your spam folder. Unconfirmed accounts are deleted after 7 days.

linkExpired.title: This link has expired
linkExpired.body: Links work for a limited time and only once. We'll send you a fresh one.

logIn.title: Log in
logIn.lockedCaption: Try again in 15 minutes, or reset your password.
logIn.securedTitle: Your account is locked for your security
logIn.securedCaption: After the email change report, our team needs to check your account. We'll email you a link to choose a new password. Waiting won't unlock it.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link.

linkSent.title: Check your inbox
linkSent.body: If an account exists for this email, we've sent you a link. It works for 1 hour.

newPassword.title: Choose a new password
newPassword.label: New password
newPassword.caption: You'll be logged out on your other devices.

closure.title: Your account is closing
closure.body: Your personal data will be erased on {{date}}. Until then, you can keep your account as it was.
closure.restored: Welcome back. Your account is active again.

emailChange.takenBody: This address can't be used for your account. Your email hasn't changed: you still log in with your current address.

report.securedBody: We've logged you out on every device and locked your account. Our team will check the email change. Then we'll email you a link to choose a new password.
report.expiredBody: For your security, this link only works for 30 days after an email change, and it can't be sent again.
report.securedCaption: You don't need to do anything else for now.
report.alreadyBody: This report is recorded and your account is locked. Our team will email you a link to choose a new password once it's checked.
report.expiredHelp: If you think someone else changed your email, contact the SparkCircles team.

rateLimited.title: Too many tries for now
rateLimited.logIn: Wait a few minutes, then try again.
rateLimited.signUp: Wait a few minutes, then try again. What you typed is kept.
rateLimited.forgotPassword: Wait a few minutes, then try again. If you've already asked, look in your inbox and spam folder.
rateLimited.resend: You've asked for several links. Wait a few minutes before asking again, and look in your spam folder.
rateLimited.wait: Wait a few minutes, then try again.

account.title: My account
account.data: Get a copy of my data

badge.verifiedA11y: Verified, identity checked by SparkCircles. Opens an explanation.

verificationCard.notVerifiedTitle: Verify your identity to host events
verificationCard.notVerifiedBody: Joining events never needs it. About 3 minutes, reviewed within 48 hours.
verificationCard.pendingBody: Usually within 48 hours. We'll let you know.
verificationCard.expiresSoonBody: Verify again with a valid document to keep hosting.
verificationCard.expiredBody: Others now see you as not verified. Verify again to host events.

profilePreview.title: How others see me
profilePreview.intro: This is exactly what other members see.
profilePreview.neverShownBody: Full last name, email, date of birth, identity document and selfie.

badgeSheet.verifiedBody: We checked an official ID and a selfie of this person.
badgeSheet.match: Their name and face match an official ID
badgeSheet.notCriminal: This is not a criminal record check
badgeSheet.judgment: Always trust your own judgment with your children.
badgeSheet.notVerifiedBody: This person hasn't checked their identity with SparkCircles. They can join events open to everyone, but can't host.

editProfile.title: Edit your profile
editProfile.city: City or neighborhood shown to others
editProfile.cityHelper: Optional. Leave empty to hide it.
editProfile.nameSheetBody: Your Verified badge will be removed. You'll need to verify again before hosting new events.

changeEmail.title: Change your email
changeEmail.intro: We'll send a link to your new address. Your current email keeps working until you confirm.
changeEmail.sentBody: We've sent a link to {{email}}. Tap it to confirm your new email. We've also told your current address about this change.

security.title: Password and devices
security.sheetBody: You'll need to log in again on every device, including this one.

dataExport.title: Get a copy of your data
dataExport.body: You'll get a file with your account, profile, consents, history and verification outcome. Usually within 48 hours, 30 days at most.
dataExport.requestedOn: Requested on {{date}}. We'll send you a notification and an email.

closeAccount.title: Close your account
closeAccount.hidden: Your profile disappears for others right away.
closeAccount.loggedOut: You're logged out on all your devices.
closeAccount.erased: Your personal data is erased in {{days}} days.
closeAccount.recover: Until then, log in to keep your account. After that, nothing can be recovered.

accountClosed.title: Your account is closed
accountClosed.body: We've sent you an email. Your data will be erased on {{date}}. Changed your mind? Log in before then.
